roadmap_steps.name: Finish single-agent host parity
roadmap_steps.summary: Standalone agent parity now includes model-agnostic vendors, external-MCP federation, deterministic context controls, token budget caps, cycle usage telemetry, and multi-turn CLI persistence.

roadmap_steps.name: Control at the boundary
roadmap_steps.summary: Standalone Musubi tool calls now pass deterministic PreToolUse policy checks and append PostToolUse audit rows, with policy verdicts and tool outcomes written to audit storage.

capabilities.name: Multi-turn CLI persistence
capabilities.evidence: agent --chat-id stores user and assistant turns in conversation_messages and replays bounded history on the next run.

capabilities.name: TokenBudgetEnforcer in the standalone host
capabilities.evidence: --max-tokens and MUSUBI_AGENT_MAX_TOKENS gate LM calls with token counts as the source of truth; estimated credits are log-only.

capabilities.name: Shared worker path
capabilities.evidence: Root tasks, workers, and summoned pipeline stages share agent/run.py::run_unit with passed-through budget and telemetry state.

capabilities.name: PreToolUse boundary
capabilities.evidence: Model-requested musubi_* tool calls are role-checked before dispatch and denied fail-closed when outside the allowed surface.

capabilities.name: PostToolUse audit
capabilities.evidence: Allowed, denied, refused, and errored Musubi tool calls append audit rows to policy_audit and tool_audit.

external_mcp_boundary: Federated external MCP tools remain outside Musubi governance in this slice; they are driver-routed convenience tools, not substrate-controlled tools.
verification_note: Local Python was unavailable on this workstation, so the new pytest coverage was written but could not be executed locally.
